name: LaGrace Beautee
description: LaGrace Beautee is a hair and beauty studio for color, cuts, styling, treatments, natural hair, and makeup — beautiful transformations that leave you in a good hair, good mood kind of glow.

hero.title: Good hair changes everything.
hero.subtitle: Color, cuts, styling, treatments, natural hair, and makeup — transformations that bring out your confidence. Come get your hair done!

stylists.name: Owner
stylists.title: Founder, Hairstylist & Makeup Artist
stylists.bio: The founder of LaGrace Beautee believes good hair changes everything. From color and cuts to natural hair care and full glam makeup, she creates transformations that bring out every client's confidence.

reviews.name: Jasmine K.
reviews.text: She did my color and makeup for my birthday and I have never felt prettier. A true transformation!

reviews.name: Tori M.
reviews.text: My silk press was so bouncy and healthy. She really cares about your hair. Good hair, good mood for real!

reviews.name: Alexis H.
reviews.text: Gorgeous cut and the friendliest vibe. I walked out feeling so confident.

reviews.name: Raven D.
reviews.text: Her full glam is flawless. My makeup lasted all night and photographed beautifully.
